baseline.precision: Own live original FP16 encoder, unmodified R124 interpolation/rotary/vision/text functions and runtime flags. No BF16, CPU trig substitution, TP-vision, GEMM/bias replacement or hidden-conditioning reuse.
baseline.acceptance: All complete same-input raw bits equal and numeric max_abs/relative_RMS exactly zero. Any measurable candidate difference, even below1%, is disabled and escalated to the user; no automatic numerical tolerance.
baseline.historical_receipt_caveat: R125 profile/profile_fa observations have nonzero differences versus saved R124 predictions and are not a hot resident-encoder baseline. Their warm field names do not prove residency/steady-state. R124's65s encoder stage includes integration and transfer; neither record proves that all time is weight offload.

cache_scope.parent_wrapper: vision.forward creates one metadata-key scope but delegates the EXACT captured original forward. The original forward still computes native cos/sin, fresh patches/all27 vision blocks/three DeepStack/merger every call.
cache_scope.miss: Call the exact original R124 function on the caller's actual grid. Return its genuine output to the first caller; retain a detached independent clone as a private geometry master. No algebraic transcription or dtype change.
cache_scope.hit: Clone the private geometry master into new caller-owned storage, preserving native logical dtype/shape/stride. Never return a shared mutable scratch buffer. Root must check actual physical-format identity as well.
key: original CPU inverse-frequency signature and72-byte raw SHA
cache_scope.why_default_dtype_in_key: Original R124 interpolation calls torch.linspace without an explicit dtype. The default dtype cannot be ignored even though output storage is FP16.
cache_scope.why_stream_in_key: Do not clone a master on another compute stream without a producer dependency. This prototype invalidates/recomputes when the lead's current-stream token changes, rather than assuming cross-stream readiness.
cache_scope.grid_reads: Exactly one grid.tolist value read at EACH complete vision entry. No per-block/attention-layer CPU reads and no pointer-only fast path for unversioned inference grids. First misses retain the original methods' own metadata reads. The extra stage-level validation must be included in candidate clocks.
cache_scope.metadata_hashing: Only original plain CPU FP32 inverse-frequency metadata is hashed in hot validation. No NPU learned weight, cached geometry master or hidden tensor is copied to CPU per hit.

budgets.policy: LRU eviction; oversize outputs return genuine originals without caching. No padding or shortened geometry.

cache_scope.costs_not_free: Private clone on misses, fresh clone on every hit, metadata validation and extra master lifetime count in time/HBM. Ownership safety deliberately avoids claiming the cached output can be shared immutably by arbitrary callers.

lifecycle_and_ownership.installation: Lead imports the candidate (stdlib only), passes the live encoder and exact staged R124 source file. File SHA and actual bound method source/class ownership are checked. Installer refuses existing unknown instance overrides; never patch module-global Torch functions or shared classes.
lifecycle_and_ownership.initial_state: Disabled by default. set_enabled(True) starts empty; the first actual fresh vision call invokes native methods and primes misses. There is no implicit model/kernel execution on import or construction of this source module.
lifecycle_and_ownership.conservative_invalidation: These hooks clear all private device masters before delegating the original method, including no-op load/to calls. This covers loaders using .data that do not advance a version counter. If actual pipeline staging invalidates before every request, cache hits may be zero and no service speed gain is proven.
lifecycle_and_ownership.external_updates: Lead must call cache.invalidate(reason) before direct .data writes or PinnedModuleStager/storage rebinding that bypasses the wrapped methods. Position weights must be immutable through a vision call. Arbitrary unreported unversioned writes cannot be detected without expensive weight reads; they are outside the permitted ownership contract.
lifecycle_and_ownership.changes: Grid value changes recompute by value key. Weight versions/config/runtime/stream changes clear and recompute or reject unsupported architecture/dtype/device. BF16 position dtype and cross-device grids fail closed, never enter an alternate graph.
lifecycle_and_ownership.during_forward: Reject reentrant execution or load/offload/parameter mutation while a vision scope is active. No asynchronous transfer policy is changed by the helper.
lifecycle_and_ownership.uninstall: All wrapper ownership is checked before any attribute is restored. A third-party wrapper causes refusal, not blind clobber. Remove outer probe wrappers first, then uninstall cache and verify private bytes0. Snapshot returns no tensor/master reference.
lifecycle_and_ownership.no_unconditional_hot_claim: Loaded flag or pos-weight device alone does not prove all77 encoder blocks are resident. Record active layerwise hooks, parameter residence and actual transfers; do not describe staged compute as hot resident compute.

lead_runtime_callback.source: Read the already-imported R124 runtime's current dtype/device/autocast/precision flags and current NPU stream at call time. Candidate imports no Torch and makes no parameter/trig substitutions. Callback must not create model tensors, transfer weights or change flags.
lead_runtime_callback.guard: The helper rejects missing/unknown keys and non-scalar metadata. Keep the entire callback content in the executed source manifest; preserve R124 allow_hf32=False controls.

lead_only_actual_fixture_tests_before_pe: Verify baseline code/parameter conversion/input grid/processor bytes and actual shared Norm/SDPA/runtime dispatch. Reproduce complete native R124 outputs repeatedly without cache first. If baseline itself varies, preserve and ask the user; do not choose a favorable native hash or use R125 profile output as gold.

Check the first enabled live call still executes both exact original geometry methods and all27 vision/all50 text layers. Compare raw first geometry outputs to cache private clones outside timers; dtype/shape/stride/NPU physical format must match.

Native-before/cache-enabled/native-restored same-input complete pairs on all8 ranks: all fresh vision block boundaries, merged+3 DeepStack, embedding, positions/masks, all50 text boundaries and final encode_ids/consumed FP16 conditioning equal bit-for-bit.

Mutate a returned hit output in an excluded diagnostic and confirm the next return/native reference is unchanged. Verify every hit output storage differs from private masters and all previous caller outputs. Full cached-master hashes before/after excluded proof confirm integrity even if inference tensors lack versions.

Different images at the same grid must rerun the entire live vision path. New grid values on the same unversioned object and a new object with identical values test value keys, miss/recompute and valid hit separately.

Change dtype/device/config/weight version; simulate a loader .data update without version advancement and direct stager invalidate. Confirm no stale master reuse, correct recomputation or explicit rejection, and zero bytes after offload/uninstall.
Verify precision flags/default dtype/stream changes reject/recompute correctly. Do not test unsupported BF16 as a new model mode or reuse another stream's master without dependency.
Oversize geometry and small entry budgets must preserve the genuine original function output via bypass/eviction, not truncate grids or add padding.

Recheck strict whole encoder identity on the current R124 request plus downstream same-input video/audio predictions at representative positions. A sampled good video or small RMS is not enough to permit changed encoder bits.

stage_measurement_plan.clean_protocol: Use the SAME resident/staged policy and full R124 arithmetic for native/candidate/restored. Start barrier+drain precede the complete clock; the original entry and ending drain are inside. Native hidden.cpu remains inside encode_ids; extra proof copies/hashes are after clock stop. No per-layer sync/event/capture reference double-compute in clean calls.

stage_measurement_plan.H2D_D2H_attribution: Use actual copy-stream/event or native profiler copy-boundary evidence for H2D/D2H, not encode_prompt-minus-forward subtraction. A diagnostic explicit copy transcription must first match the original public encode_ids including its cuDNN-SDP context/preconditions; do not use it as clean public-entry performance. Missing copy boundaries remain unassigned.
stage_measurement_plan.helper_modes: stage_profile126.py has disabled clean delegation, host_dispatch probes and synchronized_probe callbacks. Synchronized probes intentionally insert drains and change overlap; compare clean-before/probe/clean-after in a separate control run, never present probe intervals as uninstrumented speed.
stage_measurement_plan.aggregation: Each repeat gathers all8 complete wall times; report same-call rank maximum then median. A representative stage vector must come from that same call's slowest COMPLETE rank. Never sum independent rank/component maxima, inclusive parents/children or host/device durations.
required_receipts: actual resident/staged counts and active hooks
source manifests including callbacks and native dependencies
stage_measurement_plan.no_extrapolation: A zero-hit staged policy can still be correct but offer no service cache acceleration. Report measured clone/validation cost, cold miss/prime costs and true live stage. Do not subtract an old1.3s/1.83s resident benchmark from R12465s or attribute every long interval to weights.

author_validation.scope: Python syntax, source-pinning, value-key/ownership/invalidation/budget mocks and timer bookkeeping only. Lead must execute all actual NPU tensor/format/full-output gates.
